notes.title: Exciting Upcoming Adult Visual Novel!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812783/85f65573cba4bc28cfd9a4b4cfa51d90d88eb8d0.jpg

I’m thrilled to share some exciting news! 
Introducing you to our upcoming adult visual novel, In Your Shoes, created by the very talented Mac Hanson!

A New Story, New Characters, and New Experiences
    • Immerse yourself in a rich, emotional narrative with complex characters, including the captivating Norah, the kind-hearted MILF with a mysterious past (get to know her in this post)
    • Explore the game's unique themes, tackling love, loss, and longing in a thought-provoking way
    • Enjoy an engaging visual novel experience with beautifully rendered characters and deep relationships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812783/b9e9ec0df66bed751cf61d2b964148968f419326.jpg

Stay Tuned for Updates and Exclusive Content
Wishlist In Your Shoes on Steam now and get the latest updates, behind-the-scenes insights, and exclusive content!
